title: Add Why Choose Us, Privacy Policy, and Terms & Conditions to mobile hamburger menu

requirements.summary: Add 'Why Choose Us' link to mobile hamburger menu positioned after 'About Us' and before 'Products', navigating to /why-choose-us and closing the menu on tap
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Why Choose Us' link appears in the mobile hamburger menu after 'About Us' and before 'Products'
Tapping the link closes the mobile menu
The link text is driven by the nav.whyChooseUs translation key

file_operations.description: Add a 'Why Choose Us' link in the mobile hamburger menu section after the 'About Us' link and before the 'Products' link. The link must navigate to /why-choose-us, close the mobile menu using the existing setIsMobileMenuOpen(false) pattern, and display text from t('nav.whyChooseUs').

requirements.summary: Add 'Privacy Policy' link to mobile hamburger menu positioned immediately before 'Contact Us', navigating to /privacy-policy and closing the menu on tap
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Privacy Policy' link appears in the mobile hamburger menu immediately before 'Contact Us'
Tapping the link closes the mobile menu
The link text is driven by the nav.privacyPolicy translation key

file_operations.description: Add a 'Privacy Policy' link in the mobile hamburger menu section immediately before the 'Contact Us' link. The link must navigate to /privacy-policy, close the mobile menu using the existing setIsMobileMenuOpen(false) pattern, and display text from t('nav.privacyPolicy').

requirements.summary: Add 'Terms & Conditions' link to mobile hamburger menu positioned after 'Privacy Policy' and before 'Contact Us', navigating to /terms-and-conditions and closing the menu on tap
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Terms & Conditions' link appears in the mobile hamburger menu after 'Privacy Policy' and before 'Contact Us'
Tapping the link closes the mobile menu
The link text is driven by the nav.termsConditions translation key

file_operations.description: Add a 'Terms & Conditions' link in the mobile hamburger menu section after the 'Privacy Policy' link and before the 'Contact Us' link. The link must navigate to /terms-and-conditions, close the mobile menu using the existing setIsMobileMenuOpen(false) pattern, and display text from t('nav.termsConditions').

requirements.summary: Add translation keys nav.whyChooseUs, nav.privacyPolicy, and nav.termsConditions for English, Hindi, and Marathi languages
acceptanceCriteria: nav.whyChooseUs, nav.privacyPolicy, and nav.termsConditions keys exist in the en, hi, and mr translation maps
All three keys return non-empty appropriate strings for each language
No existing translation keys are removed or altered

file_operations.description: Add three new translation keys to the nav section of all three language maps (en, hi, mr): nav.whyChooseUs ('Why Choose Us' / Hindi: 'हमें क्यों चुनें' / Marathi: 'आम्हाला का निवडा'), nav.privacyPolicy ('Privacy Policy' / Hindi: 'गोपनीयता नीति' / Marathi: 'गोपनीयता धोरण'), and nav.termsConditions ('Terms & Conditions' / Hindi: 'नियम और शर्तें' / Marathi: 'अटी व शर्ती'). Ensure the new keys are added without altering any existing translation keys or structure.
